framework.primary_law: Law on Artificial Intelligence (passed 10 December 2025; in force 1 March 2026)
framework.enforcing_body: Ministry of Science and Technology and designated state management authority
framework.max_penalty: Administrative sanctions to criminal liability; amounts set by Government decree
framework.geographic_scope: Applies to AI providers and users in Vietnam, with local contact requirements for foreign providers.

source_documents.title: Vietnam's new Law on AI: Risk-based framework in force 1 March 2026
Vietnam's Law on Artificial Intelligence No. 134/2025/QH15

research.summary: Vietnam's first standalone AI law, passed on 10 December 2025 and in force from 1 March 2026, is risk-based: high-risk systems need conformity assessment before deployment, medium-risk systems carry transparency and labelling duties, and low-risk systems face minimal rules. It adds machine-tagging of generated media, serious-incident reporting through a national AI portal, a national AI database and a sandbox, with transition periods of 12 or 18 months for existing systems.

risk_tiers.description: Conformity assessment before deployment, risk management, documentation and logs.
Transparency and labelling where users may be misled.

key_provisions.title: High-risk conformity assessment
key_provisions.description: Required before deployment and after significant changes.

key_provisions.title: Generated content tagging
key_provisions.description: Machine-tagging of AI-generated audio, image and video and disclosure of misleading content.

key_provisions.title: Incident reporting
key_provisions.description: Serious malfunctions must be fixed, suspended or recalled and reported via the national AI portal.

cross_jurisdiction_tensions.tension: Vietnam's tiered model is similar to the EU's; differences in assessment bodies and state oversight create dual compliance work.

safety_risk_management.rationale: Risk tiers with conformity assessment and incident reporting.

privacy_data_protection.rationale: Unlawful data use is prohibited; details in separate data laws.

transparency.rationale: Disclosure and machine-tagging of synthetic content.

accountability.rationale: Compensation rules and authority powers to suspend systems.

research.monitor_notes: Law number reported as 134/2025/QH15 by one source; verify against the official gazette. Scores are provisional AI-drafted judgements against the AIETHOS rubric and reflect protections currently in force.

citizen.one_line: Vietnam now has a binding AI law that sorts AI by risk and requires labelling of AI-made media.
citizen.what_changed: From 1 March 2026 high-risk AI must be assessed before it is used and AI-generated media must be tagged. Systems already running have 12 to 18 months to comply.
citizen.who_is_protected: People in Vietnam affected by AI systems.
who_is_not_protected: People affected by systems still in transition periods

your_rights.right: Compensation for harm from high-risk AI
your_rights.what_it_means: If a high-risk system causes damage, the operating party pays compensation first.
your_rights.how_to_invoke: Claim against the operator; report incidents to the authority.

citizen.plain_language_summary: Vietnam's law treats risky AI more strictly and requires honesty about AI-made content.

jargon_buster.Conformity assessment: A check that an AI system meets legal requirements before it is used.
jargon_buster.Sandbox: A controlled space for testing AI under regulator supervision.
